defense_news.title: AI military targeting may move faster than humans can authenticate, critics warn
defense_news.summary: AI military targeting may move faster than humans can authenticate, critics warned during a Wednesday hearing in Washington.

defense_news.title: US ‘not prepared’ to respond to nuclear attacks in space, report says
defense_news.summary: A recent war-gaming report found that the U.S. has no tested response to a nuclear detonation in space.

defense_news.title: Israel’s SPICE 1000 bombs can soon drop from F-35 fighters
defense_news.summary: The Israeli air force can look forward to yet another bomb type for its F-35 fleet.

defense_news.title: US military must adapt as formations will be ‘hunted’ by autonomous systems, Caine says
defense_news.summary: Technology, such as AI and autonomous systems, is changing the character of war, Joint Chiefs of Staff Chairman Gen. Dan Caine said.

geo_news.title: MSB: Suudi Arabistan'ı hedef alan İHA saldırısı ile Husiler tarafından gerçekleştirilen eylemleri kınıyoruz

geo_news.title: İstanbul'da yeni nesil suç örgütlerine yönelik operasyonda yakalanan 178 şüpheli adliyede
geo_news.summary: İstanbul merkezli 20 ilde yeni nesil suç örgütlerine yönelik düzenlenen operasyonda gözaltına alınan 178 şüpheli adliyeye sevk edildi.

geo_news.title: "Mavi vatan"ın isimsiz kahramanları: "DEGAK Timi"
geo_news.summary: Sahil Güvenlik Karadeniz Bölge Komutanlığı'nda faaliyet gösteren Dalış, Emniyet, Güvenlik, Arama ve Kurtarma (DEGAK) Timi, "mavi vatan"daki zorlu mesaisini başarıyla sürdürüyor.
